payload.claim: The added docstring sentence says "`ledger` and `repo_id` are `None` together when the caller has no ledger to read, and the third place is then skipped," but the guard on line 76 is `if ledger is not None and repo_id is not None`, which skips the read whenever *either* is `None`, independently — exactly the contract the Problem section states ("skip the ledger read when either is `None`"). `saffron/cli.py`'s own `_next_id` routinely calls this with `ledger` non-`None` and `repo_id` `None` (an origin with no row for this repo, exercised by `test_next_id_prints_one_past_the_files_when_the_ledger_holds_nothing_for_the_repo`'s cases 2 and 3). The docstring's "together" phrasing describes only the all-or-nothing case and misstates the mixed case its own new caller exercises.
